site_name: ACHILLES STREET ESTATE &, 355-383 NEW CROSS ROAD, LONDON, SE14 6LA
description: Phased redevelopment of the existing site comprising demolition of Achilles Street Estate (including Azalea House, Fenton House and Austin House) and 355-383 New Cross Road, SE14 and construction of five new buildings to provide a mixed-use development comprised of residential dwellings (Class C3) and flexible commercial floorspace (Class E), together with new and enhanced public realm, landscaping, pedestrian and cycle access to Fordham Park, car and cycle parking, refuse storage, relocation of existing substation, rooftop plant equipment and all other associated works at Achilles Street Estate and 355-383 New Cross Road, SE14.
